packageRules.description: trellis owns the action, image and toolchain pins of the projects it generates, so they move here, in template/, and reach projects through their trellis update.
The stable toolchain and `rust-version` move in this repository and in the template together, so `just pins` holds in one PR. A patch release leaves `rust-version` alone.
The lints' nightly moves with `clippy_utils` and the template's `lints_nightly`, through `cargo dylint upgrade` by hand.
dylint_linting and dylint_testing are pinned to the cargo-dylint the workflows install, and move with it by hand; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
Crate updates other than major ones arrive as one PR.

A new clippy_utils is the cue to port the lints: `cargo dylint upgrade lints` moves it with the lints' nightly. Alone it can't build, so it waits on the Dependency Dashboard and opens no PR unless approved there.
Bun moves everywhere together: the image, the workflows' `bun-version:` and the template's CONTRIBUTING.md.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, move the web UI starter's packages in its `package.json.jinja` and regenerate its `bun.lock.jinja` with this Bun, as "Update pinned versions" in CONTRIBUTING.md says.

packageRules.description: A runner image moves in every workflow, CI's matrix and copier.yml's targets together.

The crates `just dependencies` adds move together. `just pins` fails until template/dylint.toml.jinja names the new version of each trusted macro crate, which is the cue to read what its macros write.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, read what each trusted macro crate's macros write at its new version and update its comment in `template/dylint.toml.jinja`, as "Update pinned versions" in CONTRIBUTING.md says.

packageRules.description: Every base image digest update, Bun's included. A new digest for the same tag often has no release time to age against, as for the unversioned Rust and distroless tags or a registry that gives none, and `timestamp-required` would hold it for good. Where a release time exists, the seven-day wait still applies.

customManagers.description: Bun in the template's workflows, which the github-actions manager can't parse, and in its CONTRIBUTING.md.
Runner images in the template's workflows, which the github-actions manager can't parse.
Runner images in CI's matrix, which the github-actions manager doesn't read.
Runner images in copier.yml's targets, which are quoted strings in a Jinja expression.
The crates tests/dependencies/setup.sh pins exactly. config:recommended ignores every tests/ directory; the ignorePaths above keep its other entries and ignore all of tests/ but tests/dependencies/.
